notes.title: Update on 21 January
notes.notes:
-Known bugs have been fixed.
-I optimized some of the visual effects.

*It was not until this version that the game was really completed, and no new levels would be added later.

But there may still be some bugs, If you find them, please contact [i]aiggoh@163.com[/i], I will be very grateful！

[b]Hope everyone can enjoy the game![/b] ^ ^

notes.title: English version officially released !
notes.notes:
I'm sorry that the English version was released a few months later than its scheduled date. 
There were many problems in the translation of the game. But the main reason is that I added some new levels at the beginning of the game, which can make it more interesting and let the players have some understanding of the game from the beginning.
Thank you for your support, I will try to release a free DLC in the near future to make up for the long wait.

notes.title: English version will be postponed for one week
notes.notes: Due to the poor quality of the translation, we changed the translator, so the English version had to be postponed for a week, which I am very sorry about. Players who purchase the game before September 30 will receive a DLC that will be released later as a compensation.

notes.title: The English version will be released before September 28.
notes.notes: Thanks for your attention! We are working hard to produce a high quality [b]English version[/b] and will be released before [b]September 28[/b].
